name: print-social-royal-blue-sticker-stars-and-pixel-icons-cover
title: Cobalt cover with four sticker portraits, glitter starbursts and pixel icons
whatItIs: A cobalt paper-textured 4:5 post with four cut-out selfies with cream borders in the corners, two glittery lilac starbursts with yellow outlines, a pixel monitor, heart and gamepad, central chunky white rounded title, a mustard pill with green handwritten text and a pixel cursor pointer.
whatItMeans: Youthful, sociable and playful; a team of faces makes the brand feel like friends.
techniques: Place cut-out portraits in the corners so the title sits in the centre.
Mix glitter starbursts with pixel-art icons.
Use a mustard pill for a secondary line with a cursor pointer.

vocabulary.definition: People cutouts placed in the four corners.
A blocky arrow pointer as decoration.
